items.title: Wilson "Chembo" Corniel interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, November 15, 2019
items.q: The transcript identifies Monk Rowe as the interviewer ('[INTERVIEWER] My name is Monk Rowe...') and the interviewee is Wilson 'Chembo' Corniel. No personal relationship beyond the professional interview context is described.

ctx.x: Chembo was interviewed in Clinton, New York on November 15, 2019 by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.

My name is Monk Rowe and we’re in the Fillius Jazz Archive. I’m very pleased to have Wilson “Chembo” Corniel with me today. And my head is still sort of spinning from that wonderful demonstration/performance that the three of you gave yesterday. And I think I mentioned to Victor that most musicians that play club dates and that kind of thing, when they get asked to play a Latin tune, everyone plays “The Girl From Ipanema.” We know that. We can play a bossa nova. And then we’re sort of stunned to learn how much…
